A couple quick asks so we can get the first payment scheduled:

- Earliest possible first payment ETA from your finance team (we're hoping for the last week of July).

Tariq — thanks for sending these over and for uploading the W-9. Received the bank letter and the CSV. Quick confirmation items from our side so the finance team can complete onboarding: 

- Micro-deposits: Our finops policy prefers micro-deposit verification for new vendors if the bank letter does not include an ACH confirmation code. If you can run the two small micro-deposits, please let us know the amounts and timestamp; we will verify. If your bank letter explicitly states the ACH routing/account policy and includes a bank contact, we can accept that in lieu of micro-deposits — we'll flag it to finance.
- Remit field: Please populate PO_NUMBER as the primary remittance field and include INVOICE_REF as secondary; our ledger ingestion maps PO_NUMBER -> invoice header for automated reconciliation.
- Invoices: ask that invoices reference the Redwood PO in the subject line and include the PO_NUMBER field in the CSV.
- First payment ETA: assuming micro-deposit verification completes this week, finance has a run scheduled for 2026-07-28. If verification is delayed, the next run is 2026-08-04.

I'm attaching the vendor-onboard-checklist PDF so you can confirm you've completed each item on your side.

If you want me to loop in Payments (Marissa) to do a quick verification call, say the word — I included her and Aditya for visibility.

Attachments: vendor-onboard-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Vendor Success Manager
Redwood Inference

- Verification: Payments verified the two micro-deposits (0.12, 0.37) against the bank account on file. Bank proof is accepted.
- Remit mapping: We're good to ingest PO_NUMBER as the primary remittance identifier. Redwood will apply the remittance string format: CG-INV:{PO_NUMBER} for our ACH reconciliation process. Please ensure the PO_NUMBER value matches the PO on the invoice PDF and in the CSV.
- First payment: Finance scheduled your first ACH run for 2026-07-28; expected settlement window 1-2 business days. We'll send a remit confirmation email once the payment posts.
- Next steps for invoices: Send a test invoice to invoices@redwood.com with the PO_NUMBER in the subject and include the remit CSV as a CSV attachment.

I've attached a short remit-confirmation-stub.txt that Payments will paste into the remittance note when sending the payment (contains the CG-INV mapping). If anything changes on your end, reply here and we'll adjust.

Thanks for moving quickly — looping Marissa and Aditya for invoicing follow-through and to close the vendor record.
